run_test_examples: run the pytest test_examples parametrized across iiwa dynamics, forward dynamics, and kinematics experiments on cpu or cuda
run_learn_dynamics_iiwa: run the learn_dynamics_iiwa experiment to learn inverse dynamics of the KUKA iiwa robot
run_learn_forward_dynamics_iiwa: run the learn_forward_dynamics_iiwa experiment to learn forward dynamics of the KUKA iiwa robot
run_learn_kinematics_of_iiwa: run the learn_kinematics_of_iiwa experiment to learn kinematics of the KUKA iiwa robot
run_learn_kinematics_of_toy: run the learn_kinematics_of_toy experiment to learn kinematics of a toy robot
